thread:
maya (AE): Hi team — scheduling kickoff with Acme for the POC. Liam said next Wed works. Can we align on agenda + must-have success criteria before the meeting?

sam (SE): +1. I can run the tech portion. Main things I want clarified: expected throughput, sample prompts, whether they want embeddings or text-gen, and any redlines for data.

liam (Acme PM): Confirming Wed 10am PT works. Our goals: 1) validate prompt accuracy on our customer support dataset, 2) measure latency at 99th percentile under a small steady load, 3) estimate cost per 1k responses.

maya (AE): Perfect. For scope: 2-week POC, sandbox org on Redwood hosted, up to 50k tokens/day. Pricing: we usually offer a trial credit and a fixed POC price if they need dedicated capacity — @tess can confirm pricing details.

tess (CSM): For commercial terms: we offer $Xk credit + option for a short reserved block if they want deterministic performance. I'll DM the exact numbers.

nora (Legal): FYI — Acme sent a security questionnaire earlier. Can we get sec to triage any high-risk items before kickoff?

sec_bot: New security request: "Acme_Sec_Questionnaire_2024.pdf" uploaded to /shared/security/acme/ — priority: high.

sam (SE): For the technical kickoff agenda I propose: 1) intros (5m) 2) POC objectives & success criteria (10m) 3) data and prompts walkthrough (15m) 4) runtime config & expected traffic (10m) 5) evaluation plan & metrics (10m) 6) next steps & timeline (10m).

maya (AE): Good. Liam — can you confirm stakeholders who should join (security, infra, product)? Also can you upload a few representative prompt examples and a small redacted dataset (<=1000 messages) before Tue EOD?

liam (Acme PM): We'll have: me (PM), Aaron (Infra), Priya (Sec), and Sara (CS lead). I'll upload 20 sample tickets and a few templates tonight. One ask: we need to lock on evaluation script so we can run comparisons consistently.

sam (SE): Suggestion for success criteria (concrete): - F1 >= 0.78 on intent classification eval (using their labels) OR top-1 accuracy >= 82% for extraction tasks. - 99th percentile latency < 600ms for single-turn gen at our sample payload. - Cost estimate within 20% of target $0.XX per response. We can adapt thresholds after we see their data.

maya (AE): These look good. Also note enterprise blockers: VPC requirement, KMS integration, and SOC2 evidence requests. Liam — any mandatory compliance items?

liam (Acme PM): We must have KMS for keys and be able to sign an addendum around data usage. SOC2 report is needed for procurement but not blocking kickoff.

nora (Legal): We'll prepare the addendum template and flag any unusual clauses.

sam (SE): Practical request: can Acme provide a sample prompt set in two formats: 1) few-shot prompt examples for generation and 2) labeled pairs for eval (input -> expected label). If they can't, we'll craft synthetic evals but results will be less meaningful.

maya (AE): I'll add these items to the calendar invite and attach the preliminary agenda. Quick draft agenda block to paste into invite:

``` 
POC Kickoff (45m)
- Intros (5m)
- Objectives & success criteria (10m)
- Data & sample prompts (10m)
- Runtime/config & traffic profile (5m)
- Eval plan & metrics (10m)
- Next steps / owners (5m)
```

maya (AE): Also, Sam — for eval automation, can you share a template script we can run against their labeled set? Even a simple curl + python scoring script is fine.

sam (SE): Yep. I'll drop a link to a repo snippet in the thread and bring it to the call. Example scoring snippet I'll share:

```
# pseudocode
def score(responses, gold):
  # compute top-1 accuracy and F1 for span extraction
  return {"accuracy": acc, "f1": f1}
```

liam (Acme PM): Sounds good. One timeline note: procurement wants a 2-week POC + 1-week extension option. We'll aim to finish evaluations by Jan 30.

maya (AE): Noted. I'll set the POC window to 2 weeks with 1 week optional extension. Tess will circulate pricing for reserved capacity if they need it.

tess (CSM): I'll include an optional quote for a small reserved pool with SLA.

sec_bot: Reminder: please review uploaded Sec questionnaire by EOD Tue.

nora (Legal): I'll take point on the addendum and review the questionnaire items flagged as high.

maya (AE): Great — owners: Maya (Engage/coord), Sam (Tech lead), Tess (Commercial), Nora (Legal), Acme: Liam/Priya/Aaron. I'll send the invite with the agenda and request uploads. Anything else?

liam (Acme PM): Please add contact for the runbook if we hit escalation during POC. Aaron will be primary infra contact.

sam (SE): I'll add a short troubleshooting/runbook doc to the invite: endpoints, common errors, and contact pager.

maya (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll circulate the invite and prep notes. :thumbsup:

sam (SE): Looking forward to it.

tess (CSM): Thanks — will share pricing shortly.
